evidence: Created brief and five implementation goals for local-only event-log cutover.
Added EventCore.swift, EventCoreTests.swift, event store/projections, and project references. Executor reports swiftc typecheck and git diff --check passed without local xcodebuild.

Shared pauseAfterRestFinish, extendWorkAfterFinish, named presets, preset selection/order now use local event log; device-local AppStorage retained. Executor reports swiftc parse and grep checks passed without local xcodebuild.

Removed activeTimerSession AppStorage dependency; active timer snapshots/clears are persisted to events.jsonl and restore reads event-log projection. Executor reports swiftc parse, grep checks, and diff check passed without local xcodebuild.
StatsStore now appends statsRecordAppended events to events.jsonl and reloads records from event projection; old session-records.jsonl ignored. Executor reports diff checks and workflow unchanged.
Adjusted TBLocalEventLog.append to reload persisted envelopes before allocating the next sequence so StatsStore and Timer appends share events.jsonl more safely.
Architect review CLEAR after APNs removal; code-review APPROVE after fixes for preset seeding, explicit timer events, restore session identity, terminal session clearing, and stats dedupe.
